title: THE RUN CARD HEADINGS ARE READABLE
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K pictures of the death and extract cards. The HOW DID THAT RUN FEEL heading over the feel tags was the smallest text on the card, smaller than the tags it heads, so from the couch on a TV it was hard to make out. It is two points bigger now, still a touch under the tags so it reads as their heading, and the HOW IT WENT heading over the hits on a death card got the same size so the two match.
now: The headings on the death and extract card are bigger and easier to read.
